theorem.global_deduplication_boundary: A globally deduplicated exact product dictionary still has exactly |C5| target entries.
theorem.iid_support_inheritance: Under the R119 iid-distinct-support theorem at |C|=B^(3/4+o(1)), |C5|=B^(15/4+o(1)) with high probability.
theorem.model: Arbitrary hashes h2:C2->A and h3:C3->B, plus an explicit correction list L_(a,b) containing every distinct product xy for x in C2 bucket a and y in C3 bucket b.
not_covered: adaptive probes into compressed correction data
nonlinear algebraic certificates not listing product targets
general arithmetic circuits or data structures
scope_limits: globally deduplicated explicit exact product dictionaries
exact membership with represented product keys
theorem.source_backpointer_consequence: Attaching one C2 and one C3 source to each represented product does not reduce the number of represented product entries.
